market.worldSizeUSD_B_range: Estimates vary: $10.64B (2024) to $14.39B by 2030 (5.2%/yr, Grand View Research); $11.15B (2024) to $15.46B by 2030 (5.6%/yr); $12.8B (2023) to $23.7B by 2030 (9.1%/yr, Strategic Market Research). Broader cosmetics contract-manufacturing + private-label market: $80B (2024) to $135.41B by 2032 (6.8%/yr).
exportGeographies: Latin America (per GLINT Cosmetics' own self-claimed footprint, 55+ countries)
globalCompetitors: not applicable globally — this is a fragmented, regionally-served CMO market; see peers[] for Indian comparables
market.domesticSlice: India has a large, professionalizing contract-manufacturing base historically built around FMCG majors, now scaling to serve the D2C beauty wave; many D2C brands launch entirely asset-light through Indian CMOs. Herbal/Ayurvedic formulations are estimated at 35-40% of total India contract-manufacturing demand.

structureFacts: Clean-beauty/ingredient-transparency trend: brands increasingly demand claims like 'clean,' 'cruelty-free,' 'paraben-free,' pushing brands toward CMOs that support low-MOQ, niche formulations
D2C beauty brand growth is the primary structural driver of contract-manufacturing demand — many brands launch asset-light entirely through CMOs

adoptionStructure.note: Relationship-driven repeat business once a brand's formulation and supply chain are qualified with a given manufacturer — not a fixed repurchase-rate category

steps: formulate, fill and package private-label/white-label personal-care SKUs (skincare, haircare, baby care, color cosmetics)
maintain regulatory compliance (FDA/Halal/ISO-type certifications) across export markets

purchase orders/contracts from D2C brands, distributors, export clients
